name: 食品包裝機
lead: 包子、鳳梨酥、太陽餅、喜餅、菠蘿麵包、三明治、銅鑼燒、蛋黃酥，整顆或連托盤一起包。
lead_en: Buns, pineapple cakes, sun cakes, wedding pastries, sandwiches, dorayaki — with or without trays.

name: 糖果包裝機
lead: 牛軋糖、黑糖塊、黏性糖果，怕黏、怕碎的糖也包得漂亮。
lead_en: Nougat, brown sugar cubes and sticky candies — clean seals even on tacky products.

name: 卡片包裝機
lead: 儲值卡、遊戲卡全自動計數、疊卡、包裝，一包 8 張也能自動完成。
lead_en: Fully automatic counting, stacking and wrapping of stored-value and game cards — e.g. 8 cards per pack.

name: 面紙與紙品包裝機
lead: 袖珍包、候選人包、擦手紙、抽取式衛生紙、捲筒衛生紙與廚房紙巾。
lead_en: Pocket tissues, promotional packs, hand towels, facial tissue boxes, toilet rolls and kitchen towels.

name: 民生用品與特殊需求包裝機
lead: 口罩、刮鬍刀、牙刷、棉花棒、免洗餐具、環保餐具，或任何你說不準怎麼包的東西，都可以談。
lead_en: Face masks, razors, toothbrushes, cotton swabs, disposable and reusable tableware — and anything unusual.
